In [[mathematics]], '''Drinfeld reciprocity''', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Drinfeld|authorlink=Vladimir Drinfeld|year=1974}},  is a correspondence between eigenforms of the moduli space of [[Drinfeld module]]s and factors of the corresponding [[Jacobian variety]], such that all twisted L-functions are the same.
